item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02370","case1_error":"Treats four total overtime hours as four hours each day, multiplying the overtime pay by five.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final ratio 11/2 after correct formulas, which yield 2530/253 = 10.","reason":"The first incorrectly repeats overtime across days; the second supplies an incorrect final number after a correct setup.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02371","case1_error":"Performs four halving-and-donation rounds instead of the requested two.","case2_error":"Calculates reading speed using the old daily page count divided by the new reading time.","reason":"The first executes extra repetitions; the second mixes quantities from different periods to derive an incorrect rate.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02372","case1_error":"Uses four bags as the number of peanuts, omitting the 30 peanuts per bag.","case2_error":"Includes the half-hour break as time spent driving at 60 miles per hour.","reason":"The first confuses container count with item count; the second applies driving speed during a stationary break.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02373","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 36 × 9 as 432 within the correctly written volume expression.","case2_error":"Supplies unsupported final total 960 after correctly writing 120 + (6 × 120), which yields 840.","reason":"The first shows a specific erroneous arithmetic evaluation; the second gives a wrong final number without showing its calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02374","case1_error":"Treats 90 seconds per ear as 90 seconds for the entire cat, omitting the second ear.","case2_error":"Reports this month's earnings after the raise instead of total earnings for both months.","reason":"The first fails to scale a per-ear duration by ear count; the second answers the wrong requested quantity.","judgment":"different"}]}
